name: Saegusa Shouta
source:
A classmate of the protagonist.
He is actually the younger of the Shingyouji brothers, however he goes by his mothers last name. He's actually only Yuuto's half-brother.
He's known as a delinquent around school for his scary looks, but he acts nice to the protagonist.
